critical_code_review_comments: package.json cleanup looks correct: `overrides` uses $-references so ajv/ajv-keywords/schema-utils are pinned consistently; eslint chain downgraded to v8 as required by react-scripts 5. Consider adding a README note documenting that Node 18/20 is required (matches the new `engines` field) so Windows users on Node 21+ get a fast, clear failure.

craco.config.js correctly filters out ESLintWebpackPlugin from webpack.plugins to bypass the winston `defaultMeta` bug — but linting is no longer part of the dev/prod build. Recommend documenting `npm run lint` in README so contributors know how to run ESLint explicitly, and consider wiring it into a pre-commit hook or CI step to avoid silent lint drift.

The `.npmrc` sets `legacy-peer-deps=true` globally in the repo — this is required for the React 19 + react-scripts 5 peer-dep mismatch but does mean any newly added dependency will not be peer-validated. Low risk given the pinned override tree, just worth being aware of.
No behavioural code changes this iteration; UI/data still matches iteration-4 acceptance criteria (93 catalogue cards, 8 gallery tiles, 6 fast-food groups, Order Now dropdown links intact).
